title: Ye-beg-alicha
description: A buttery, springy Ethiopian dish featuring almonds, perfect for a sattvic-friendly breakfast or snack.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the all-purpose flour, almonds, and cardamom powder.
Beat in the egg, vanilla extract, and melted butter until well combined.
Add the powdered milk and mix until a dough forms.
Turn the dough onto a floured surface and knead for 10 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 6-8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer the cooked disks to a plate and let cool slightly.
To make the icing, mix the powdered milk and icing sugar in a small bowl until smooth.
Dip each cooked disk into the icing and then immediately submerge into an ice bath to shock.
Once the disks have cooled, they are ready to serve.
Serve warm or at room temperature, garnished with additional almonds if desired.
